description: Tamil Nadu unveils an industrial roadmap, investing ₹3,200 crore in parks and AI services to boost MSMEs and job creation.
body_lead: The Tamil Nadu government has unveiled an ambitious industrial roadmap to transform the State into a $1.5-trillion economy by 2036, with a focus on balanced regional development, advanced manufacturing and employment generation. Presenting the 2026-27 Budget in the Assembly on Wednesday, Finance Minister N. Marie Wilson announced that SIPCOT would establish new industrial parks in industrially backward districts based on district-specific industrial plans and sectoral strengths.
